csvtable-download: Fallback link label shown when a CSV file cannot be read or rendered.
csvtable-error-unreadable: Shown when an embedded CSV file cannot be read.
csvtable-error-too-large:
Shown when an embedded CSV file exceeds the size cap. Parameters:
* $1 — the limit in bytes.
csvtable-error-too-many-rows:
Shown when an embedded CSV file exceeds the row cap. Parameters:
* $1 — the row limit.
csvtable-error-too-many-columns:
Shown when an embedded CSV file exceeds the column cap. Parameters:
* $1 — the column limit.
